rule: Each case states its input, the required outcome and the forbidden outcome, and names the node whose test makes it executable. VID0 ships no test; the executable owner adds it. Release strings below are the exact releases a fixture pins; the admitted lines themselves belong to each family's stage-0 lock.

cases.name: lineage survives edits
cases.input: One carrier file, edited twice; the script and template regions survive both edits
cases.required: SourceUnitId for each logical role is equal across the three versions; SourceRevision and ContentId differ per version; MapRevision differs exactly when the map construction changes
cases.forbidden: A SourceUnitId that changes with revision or content; any constructor deriving SourceUnitId from a path or revision; a lineage repair applied after the unit is minted

cases.name: Vue 2.6 and Vue 3 coexist
cases.input: One workspace with package A resolving vue 2.6 and package B resolving vue 3; one .vue file in each with identical bytes
cases.required: Both files share one CarrierProfileId; they get two distinct ReleaseIds and two distinct FrameworkProfileIds; their semantic cache keys differ; no code path branches on the family name to tell them apart
cases.forbidden: A family-wide 'vue' key shared by both; a behavior branch on major inside one profile; either package silently treated as the other's release
cases.note: Identity-level only. No Vue 2 vertical is admitted, so the Vue 2.6 profile identity is a fixture value, not a supported product.

cases.name: one TSX byte stream, exclusive React and Solid 2 claims
cases.input: The same .tsx bytes under a React 19 package and under a Solid 2 package, and once under a React package with a @jsxImportSource solid-js pragma
cases.required: One CarrierProfileId (TSX) and one RegionId in every case; the React and Solid 2 claims are two distinct FrameworkProfileIds and two distinct AttachmentIds on that one RegionId; with no narrowing, two active claims on the RegionId yield typed ambiguous; the pragma narrows that one file to Solid 2
cases.forbidden: A React profile derived from the Solid claim or the reverse; both claims active on one RegionId without a typed ambiguous outcome; ambiguity decided by AttachmentId equality, which never matches across profiles

cases.name: Solid 1 cannot activate Solid 2
cases.input: A package whose resolved solid-js is 1.x
cases.required: No Solid 2 ReleaseId or FrameworkProfileId can be produced from it; activation reports unsupported-version
cases.forbidden: Solid 2 semantics on a Solid 1 package; a dual-version profile

cases.name: older htmx majors cannot activate htmx 4
cases.input: A package whose resolved htmx.org major is below 4
cases.required: No htmx 4 ReleaseId or FrameworkProfileId can be produced from it; an admitted older major gets its own profile, otherwise unsupported-version
cases.forbidden: The htmx 4 vocabulary applied to an older major; one profile spanning two majors

cases.name: floating and untagged identities fail schema validation
cases.input: Profile descriptors naming 'latest', 'next', a range such as ^3, a bare family string such as "vue", an untagged string id, a descriptor with no major, and a versions array
cases.required: Each fails canonical decoding with a typed error
cases.forbidden: Any of them decoding into a ReleaseId, FrameworkProfileId or ProjectProfileId; a decoder defaulting the major

cases.name: nominal distinctness
cases.input: A CarrierProfileId passed where a FrameworkProfileId or ProjectProfileId is required; an AttachmentId passed where a RegionId is required
cases.forbidden: A type alias, a shared base type or an implicit conversion that accepts it
existingEvidence: the existing verter_identity compile-fail fixtures prove the same property for other identity pairs

cases.name: source key serialization and collision
cases.input: (SourceUnitId, SourceRevision, ContentId) and (SourceUnitId, SourceRevision, MapRevision) tuples, including two tuples whose concatenated payload bytes coincide
cases.required: Exact round-trip through the canonical encoding; colliding payloads encode to different bytes and different digests; no backend, engine or provider identity appears in the key
cases.forbidden: A key that includes EngineIdentity, ProviderEpoch or a session handle; equality decided by digest alone on a suspected collision

cases.name: Qwik is Qwik 2 only
cases.input: A package resolving @builder.io/qwik 1.x, and one resolving the pinned Qwik 2 core
cases.required: Qwik 1 is unsupported-version; Qwik 2 activates the one Qwik profile, so Qwik-2-only rules need no in-profile version gate
cases.forbidden: A Qwik 1 package receiving Qwik 2 semantics; a Qwik profile whose behavior branches on major
cases.note: QWK0 is docs-only and fixes the pinned release. Its executable rejection proof belongs to QWK1: the lock validator (QWK1-ACV) and activation rejection (QWK1-AC4).

cases.name: resolved, not declared, and incremental
cases.input: A package declaring react ^18 || ^19 with 18.3 installed, then upgraded to 19
cases.required: unsupported-version before the upgrade, then the React 19 profile; incremental activation after the edit equals fresh activation
cases.forbidden: Activation from the declared range; a stale profile after the upgrade

cases.name: a release change moves exactly its dependent identities
cases.input: One .vue unit with fixed bytes and regions, minted once under the Vue 2.6 release and once under the Vue 3 release (identity-level fixture values, as in VC02)
cases.required: CarrierProfileId, SourceUnitId and RegionId are equal across both; ReleaseId, FrameworkProfileId, AttachmentId and the profile-qualified CapabilityId differ, as do the catalog snapshot identities that register them
cases.forbidden: A dependent identity left unchanged, aliasing two releases in one key; a carrier, source or region identity that changes with the release
